text:
morgan: Quick heads-up — planning a coordinated version rollout tomorrow 10:00am PST. Order: api -> runtime -> console -> sdks. Please confirm readiness (changelog, migration notes, branch tags). If you can't, shout now.

sasha: API team good. PRs merged to main; tagging release/api@v0.15.0 in 30m. Changelog already in PR, needs a short migration note for header parsing.

ben: Runtime: building quantized image now. ETA ~2h. Will pin image tag `runtime:v0.15.0-qat` and push to staging registry. Need to confirm API contract change? any schema bump?

carla: Console: hold for API contract freeze. We have a UI flag behind `feature.new-headers`. If API changes header shape we need a small patch. Can we coordinate a canary window?

morgan: Yes — we'll do a 30m canary post API rollout. Ben, if runtime image is ready before API cutoff, we can stage it but not route traffic.

dani: SDKs: I have a minor semver patch ready (0.15.0 -> 0.15.1?) depending on API. If header changes, I'll add optional arg + migration note. Can we lock proto by 9:30am PST?

alice: Ops: I'll open the rollout doc and add the timeline. Also creating a guard in the router: if `x-new-headers` missing, route to legacy model. That gives us graceful fallback. :thumbsup: 

release-bot: Reminder: Cutoff for non-security changes is 09:45:00 PST. Automated changelog generation will run at 09:50. Tag check: `git ls-remote --tags origin | grep v0.15`

sasha: Confirmed: API schema change is limited to header optionality, not body. We'll merge channel note and tag at 09:10 so canary at ~10:05.

ben: Runtime image built and pushed: `ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:v0.15.0-qat`. Will delay rollout hooks until after API tag. Please validate internal integration test `make integ-test`.

carla: Console patch queued in PR #4823, depends on API tag. I'll wait for the tag then run visual smoke tests. If anything flakey, ping here asap.

dani: SDK PR #845 opened, adds `headersCompatibility` flag and docs. If API tag goes out I'll cut npm release after canary.

morgan: Sounds good. Actions: Sasha tag at 09:10, Ben hold image until post-tag canary, Alice ops guard in place, Dani ready to cut SDK after canary, Carla run UI smoke. If any blocker call immediate rollback and notify #incidents. Thanks everyone :rocket:
